claim_boundary: locate frozen public-evidence calibration across order/time; not information erasure, causal memory ownership, calibrated uncertainty, learning or adaptation
support: exhaustive unique binary prefixes; deduplicate before fitting/evaluation: cue2=4, cue4=16, cue6/delay=64. Repeated future suffixes checked exactly, never reweighted as training samples
primary: cue6 and delays only; cue2/cue4 descriptive small-support localization, not categorical onset evidence
label: public prefix Bayesian reference log odds; no hidden target or resolve frame enters system
fit_modes: time_refit: train on one order at each checkpoint, frozen evaluate other order. cue_end_frozen: freeze cue6 fit/projection/scale, evaluate both orders through delays
channel_probes: six channels projected separately, descriptive decoding availability, not causal ownership or necessity
controls: current and latest public encodings, schedule-only, and full-state conditional train-label shuffle within latest-symbol strata; reliability fixed within each order/time. Shuffle seed=model_seed*10000+fit_tick*100+projection_seed; retain changed-label count
schedule_control_boundary: one-order schedule vector constant across histories; trivial negative sanity only, not substantive exclusion of schedule exploitation
analytic_public_controls: current/latest single-cue log odds from known public reliability semantics, no evaluation-label fitting; avoids weak frozen latest baseline trained on a neutral last cue. No accumulated-history oracle predictor used as model evidence
public_control_identity: at evidence checkpoints current and latest semantic controls identical; learned latest remains deliberately train-support-limited
decision_rule: primary time-refit projected full-state R2 must exceed analytic latest and matched projection-seed shuffled control in every declared projection/parameter seed for a seed-robust decoding statement; otherwise mixed or unestablished. Frozen cue6 temporal R2<0 denotes worse-than-mean calibration, not erasure. No early categorical onset or automatic status promotion
calibration: prediction=slope*oracle+intercept descriptive regression; R2, correlation and MAE; no evaluation-label calibration applied to predictions
state_diagnostics: order and cue6-reference centroid shifts, full/channel norms; raw-scale summaries non-causal
falsifier: frozen primary projected-state decoding fails to exceed matched public/shuffle controls across fresh seeds; inability to decode does not prove erasure
scope: four independent parameter seeds; two fixed orders, prefix histories, checkpoints, projections and channels dependent within seed; no threshold search or architecture change
